title: channel_plan.py: select_channel returns out-of-bounds index for small channel plans
description: Lines 87-88 (method) and 311-312 (function): When num_channels < 3, the formula `n = max(self.num_channels - 1, 2); return 1 + (h % n)` can return indices exceeding valid range. For num_channels=1, returns 1 or 2 (only index 0 valid). For num_channels=2, returns 1 or 2 (index 2 invalid). All predefined plans have 8+ channels so this only affects custom/future plans with fewer than 3 channels.
close_reason: Duplicate fully resolved by closed beads edq7/j3rf: the shared bounded selector maps one-channel plans to CH0, two-channel plans to CH1, rejects nonpositive counts, and keeps both public APIs identical. Existing canonical vectors and exhaustive boundary tests cover counts 1/2/3/4/8/64, density fallback, and u32 epoch boundaries. Verified 176 focused channel/CCP tests (1 skipped), 738 vector/regional-plan tests, Ruff, and strict mypy green; no additional edits.
